title: Out-of-range clip gain and fader onto Utility devices; 1024-clip performance bound
description:
## Intent

Keep levels outside the DAW's ranges, with warnings; keep large scores fast.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/levels.rs`: clip gain and fader ranges from `design/daw-set.md`; per track, the part of the clip gain that is beyond range for any clip moves onto a Utility gain at the start of the track's chain (all its clips lowered by the same amount); fader beyond range: the remainder on a Utility at the end of the chain. Warnings name the track and the dB moved.
- Performance: a 64-bar score of sixteenth-note steps (1024 clips) exports in under 10 s in a debug build; no quadratic id or lane allocation.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Levels beyond the DAW's ranges" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): keep levels beyond the DAW's ranges`. Not breaking.
